name: 選んだメッセージの一括操作バー
prompt:
Create one compact Japanese selected-message toolbar on a white canvas, exactly 390 × 72 px in layout (very wide 5.42:1). The Japanese native preview is the exact reference for target dimensions, icon order, spacing and copy. The source crop supplies the selected-count and toolbar concept. No device frame, wallpaper, message bubble, watermark, or extra controls.

Arrange one horizontal toolbar row: at far left, a small gray curved reply/back arrow; centered, bold dark text `4件を選択`; near the right, a gray outline trash icon; at far right, a gray outline share/send arrow. Keep icons thin, simple, evenly aligned to the same vertical center. Preserve the native preview’s white background and very subtle top divider around y=8. Keep generous horizontal separation with a compact 72px height.

The count text is a selection status, not a hyperlink. Keep it dark, not blue. There is no linked text in this component. Do not add any blue text, color icon strokes blue, or invent additional labels. Use clean crisp Japanese sans-serif lettering and preserve the exact copy and icon order.
reviewNotes: Correct Japanese toolbar copy and gray icon order, but output has excess top margin and a taller canvas than the 390x72 native preview.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
